---
title: "R code to generate Change from baseline across PRO domains (table)"
output: html_document
params:
    continuous_data: NA
    no_doseF: NA
    func_F: NA
    final_tF: NA
    continuous_date: NA
    title: NA
    column1: NA
    width: NA
---

```{r}
print(params[-1])

## To install the required packages, uncomment the following lines and run the code
# install.packages(c("ggplot2", "DT", "magrittr", "dplyr", "ggsurvfit", "ggh4x", "tidyr", "gt", "gridExtra", "survminer"))
library(ggplot2)
library(DT)
library(magrittr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggsurvfit)
library(ggh4x)
library(tidyr)
library(gt)
library(gridExtra)
library(survminer)

# Define the parameters
continuous_data <- params$continuous_data
no_doseF <- params$no_doseF
func_F <- params$func_F
final_tF <- params$final_tF
continuous_date <- params$continuous_date
column1 <- params$column1

# Function to handle date data
date_to_timepoint_continuous <- function(data) {
    data %>%
        group_by(id, functioning) %>%
        arrange(timepoint) %>%
        mutate(date = timepoint, timepoint = row_number() - 1) %>%
        ungroup()
}

# Logic handling PRO domain format for the data
continuous_data$functioning <- as.character(continuous_data$functioning)

# Logic handling date format for the data
if (continuous_date == TRUE) {
    continuous_data <- date_to_timepoint_continuous(continuous_data) %>% select(-date)
}

# Filter to specific PRO domain, dose, and timepoints
continuous_data <- continuous_data %>%
    filter(dose %in% no_doseF) %>%
    filter(functioning %in% func_F) %>%
    filter(timepoint <= final_tF)

# Create a data frame with the number of patients at each timepoint and the number of patients missing at each timepoint
ice_n_patF <- continuous_data %>%
    group_by(dose, id) %>%
    summarise(n_timepoints = n_distinct(timepoint), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(dose) %>%
    mutate(max_timepoints = max(n_timepoints)) %>%
    filter(n_timepoints < max_timepoints) %>%
    summarise(n_patients_missing = n_distinct(id))

# Find first and last timepoints
final_list <- unique(continuous_data %>% filter(timepoint <= final_tF) %>% select(timepoint))
final_in_list <- max(final_list$timepoint)
first_in_list <- min(unique(continuous_data$timepoint))
finalT <- as.symbol(paste0("tp_", final_in_list))
firstT <- as.symbol(paste0("tp_", first_in_list))

# Create data frame with change from baseline for each PRO domain
dfF <- continuous_data %>%
    group_by(functioning) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = score, names_prefix = "tp_", id_cols = c(id, dose, functioning)) %>%
    mutate(score = !!finalT - !!firstT) %>%
    dplyr::select(id, score, dose, functioning)

# Add columns containing the number of unreported and reported patients
dfF <- dfF %>%
    group_by(dose, functioning) %>%
    mutate(non_na_count = sum(!is.na(score))) %>%
    mutate(na_count = sum(is.na(score))) %>%
    ungroup()

# Create a summary data frame with the mean, standard error, and 95% confidence intervals for each PRO domain and dose
sum.dfF <- dfF %>%
    group_by(dose, functioning) %>%
    summarise(
        mean = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE),
        non_na_count = unique(non_na_count),
        se = sd(score, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(non_na_count), .groups = "keep"
    )

sum.dfF <- sum.dfF %>% mutate(l.ci = mean - (1.96 * se))
sum.dfF <- sum.dfF %>% mutate(u.ci = mean + (1.96 * se))
sum.dfF <- sum.dfF %>% ungroup(dose)

# Reshape data frame for use in generating the table
sum.df.widerF <- sum.dfF %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = functioning, names_from = dose, values_from = c(mean, se, non_na_count))

# Generate the table
sum.df.wider.gt <- sum.df.widerF %>%
    gt(row_group_as_column = TRUE) %>%
    tab_stubhead(label = if (isTruthy(column1)) {
        column1
    } else {
        "Functioning"
    })

for (i in unique(sum.dfF$dose)) {
    sum.df.wider.gt <- sum.df.wider.gt %>% tab_spanner(label = paste0("Dose ", i), columns = ends_with(as.character(!!i)))
    sum.df.wider.gt <- sum.df.wider.gt %>% cols_label(
        starts_with("mean") ~ "Mean",
        starts_with("se") ~ "Standard Error",
        starts_with("non_na_count") ~ "Number Reported"
    )
}

sum.df.wider.gt %>%
    opt_stylize(style = 5, color = "blue") %>%
    tab_header(title = params$title) %>%
    tab_options(table.width = px(params$width))
```
